text: Item 3(b) Cement plants: Category A: >= 1.0 million tonnes/annum production capacity. Category B: < 1.0 million tonnes/annum production capacity. All Standalone grinding units are Category B. Conditions if any: General Condition shall apply. Substituted by S.O. 3518(E), dated 23.11.2016.

General Condition (GC): Any project or activity specified in Category 'B' will be appraised at the Central Level as Category 'A', if located in whole or in part within 5 km from the boundary of: (i) Protected Areas notified under the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972 (53 of 1972); (ii) Critically Polluted areas as identified by the Central Pollution Control Board from time to time; (iii) Eco-sensitive areas as notified under sub-section (2) of section 3 of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, and (iv) inter-State boundaries and international boundaries: Provided that for River Valley Projects specified in item 1(c), Thermal Power Plants specified in item 1(d), Industrial Estates/ parks/complexes/areas specified in item 7(c) and common hazardous waste treatment, storage and disposal facilities (TSDFs) specified in item 7(d), the appraisal shall be made at Central level even if located within 10 km. Substituted by S.O. 1599(E) dated 25.06.2014.

clause: Paragraph 4(iii) - Categorization of projects and activities
text: Paragraph 4(iii): All projects or activities included as Category 'B' in the Schedule, including expansion and modernization of existing projects or activities, but excluding those which fulfill the General Conditions (GC) stipulated in the Schedule, will require prior environmental clearance from the State/Union territory Environment Impact Assessment Authority (SEIAA) in the respective State or Union territory on the recommendation of a State or Union territory Level Expert Appraisal Committee (SEAC).

clause: Paragraph 4(ii) - Categorization of projects and activities
text: Paragraph 4(ii): All projects or activities included as Category 'A' in the Schedule, including expansion and modernization of existing projects or activities and projects or activities fulfilling the General Condition, shall require prior environmental clearance from the Central Government in the Ministry of Environment and Forests (MoEF) on the recommendations of an Expert Appraisal Committee (EAC) to be constituted by the Central Government.

Item 1(d) Thermal Power Plants: Category A: >= 500 MW (coal/lignite based), >= 50 MW (biomass or non-coal). Category B: < 500 MW (coal/lignite based), < 50 MW (biomass or waste to energy). Conditions: General Condition shall apply (appraised at Central level if located within 10 km of sensitive areas). Substituted by S.O. 1599(E) dated 25.06.2014.

Item 8(a) Building and Construction projects: Category B: >= 20,000 sq.mtrs and < 1,50,000 sq.mtrs of built-up area. Note: General Condition shall not apply. Substituted by S.O. 695(E) dated 04.04.2011.

Footnote 92: S.O. 3999(E) dated 09.12.2016 regarding exemption of building and construction projects was quashed by the Hon'ble National Green Tribunal in judgment dated 08.12.2017 (Society for Protection of Environment & Biodiversity vs Union of India). Furthermore, S.O. 5733(E) and S.O. 5736(E) dated 15.11.2018 are recorded as not in force. Where amendments conflict or have been quashed, the principal notification governs or human escalation is required.

clause: Procedure for environmental clearance regarding wildlife clearance
text: Office Memorandum dated 08.08.2019: Clarification regarding prior clearance from Standing Committee of National Board for Wildlife (SC-NBWL). Any project located within 10 km from the boundary of a National Park or Wildlife Sanctuary where an Eco-Sensitive Zone has not been notified requires wildlife clearance from SC-NBWL. Note that wildlife clearance is a distinct statutory requirement under the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972 and does not substitute or override the categorisation rules (5 km GC) under EIA Notification 2006.

clause: Coastal Regulation Zone Projects Out of Corpus
text: Notice: Projects located within the Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) such as coastal resorts, marine facilities, port expansions, and coastal aquaculture are governed by the Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) Notification, 2019 / 2011 under Section 3 of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986. They are appraised by the National Coastal Zone Management Authority (NCZMA) or State Coastal Zone Management Authority (SCZMA), not through the standard EIA 2006 Schedule. These fall outside the EIA Notification 2006 corpus.
